pixel_source_policy: Only original.mp4 decoded RGB/source.png were inspected. No reference pixels, generation, repaint, source mutation or mask changes.

adjacent_difference_check.rgb_test: maximum absolute difference across RGB per pixel; counts >16 and >64
adjacent_difference_check.petal_exclusion: Union of both frames where R>70, B>40, R>B, B>G+15, R>G+30, dilated by five pixels. Colour exclusion is heuristic, not a semantic proof.
adjacent_difference_check.full_frame_crosscheck: All 239 adjacent pairs additionally compared over 1920x1080 using dark-line membership max(R,G,B)<60 XOR, same petal exclusion, and max RGB difference >64. This includes peripheral gloves outside the central ROI.
adjacent_difference_check.limitation: Metrics selected likely changes and cross-checked visual findings; they do not prove author-cel equality or exclude hidden/subpixel changes.

catalog_source_pixel_equality.comparison: Decoded RGB equality for each catalog source.png versus its exact restored source-frame PNG, not PNG byte-encoding equality.

findings_zh: 在M28连续82帧和M29连续158帧共240帧中，按本报告方法未发现目录外的额外可见人物绘制态。现有X01的19个与X02的30个源帧样本均与原片对应帧RGB一致。此结论仅限这两段的可见区域，不是全片或作者原图完整性的证明。
F4021仅持续1帧，但头眼、裙摆和腿部等结构确与F4022不同；X01-01须保持独立，准确曝光为PTS 2147216至2147744（1/16000秒单位）。
红裙段的手势、衣线、眼态变化不应归入花瓣、字幕或镜头运动。各目录切换含可见姿势/线条改变，末尾F4255的相近姿势也保留为独立可见线态；不据此宣称49张唯一作者原图。
F4185的显著全图差异主要来自上方歌词更换，花瓣同时继续运动；面部及公共可见手势未见新稿。
F4054和F4204的零散像素差异经原尺寸脸、手和线条对照未见结构性新姿，符合编码刷新而非新增绘制态。编码类型不是视觉态等同的充分证据。

uncertainty.hidden_regions: Petals, text and crop boundaries obscure portions of the character. Hidden lines, hidden one-frame changes, transparency and author-cel identity remain unresolved; they were not invented or reconstructed.
uncertainty.inspection_resolution: All 240 full frames were inspected in consecutive 480px-wide contacts; only listed candidates were inspected at native-size crops. This is not a native-size full-frame examination of every frame.
uncertainty.camera_and_composition: No camera-only transition was promoted to an additional drawing state. Similar composition alone does not justify merging distinct visible linework. No inverse camera transform or source-cel deduplication is claimed.
uncertainty.global_scope: No assertion that every original drawing state in the 4763-frame film is captured. Other chapters and obstructed author drawings require their own evidence.
uncertainty.semantic_layer_quality: This report evaluates visible state coverage, not segmentation mask quality or clean source-cel recoverability.
